meta.title: AgentBridge — MCP Stdio Transport Architecture
meta.subtitle: Process Isolation, Stream Multiplexing, Stderr Diagnostics & Security Controls
meta.description: System architecture of the Phase 7.6 Model Context Protocol (MCP) Stdio Transport in AgentBridge. Illustrates subprocess management, stream separation (stdin/stdout/stderr), framing protection, secret sanitization, cross-platform teardown, and integration with the AgentBridge Connector ecosystem.

components.label:
MCPConnector
(sutra/connectors/mcp/connector.py)
components.description: Standard AgentBridge Connector abstraction integrating the MCP client session, routing operations, and coordinating ActivityStore audits.

components.label:
MCPClient
(sutra/connectors/mcp/client.py)
components.description: High-level domain client managing tools, resources, prompts, and bounded cursor pagination.

components.label:
MCPSession
(sutra/connectors/mcp/session.py)
components.description: Protocol coordinator maintaining session FSM (READY/DEGRADED/ERROR) and executing version negotiation.

components.label:
StdioMCPTransport
(sutra/connectors/mcp/stdio.py)
components.description: Concrete transport implementing MCPTransport over local child process stdin/stdout/stderr streams with framing protection.

components.label:
MCPStdioConfig
(sutra/connectors/mcp/stdio.py)
components.description: Strongly typed configuration specifying command executable, argument arrays, timeout parameters, and sanitized environment rules.

components.label:
Child MCP Process
(Local Subprocess)
components.description: Local process executed with shell=False, receiving protocol requests on stdin and emitting protocol responses on stdout.

components.label:
Bounded Stderr Ring Buffer
(sutra/connectors/mcp/stdio.py)
components.description: Non-blocking ring buffer capturing up to max_stderr_lines/bytes of diagnostic output without deadlocking or polluting stdout.

components.label:
ActivityStore
(sutra/activity_store.py)
components.description: SQLite audit repository recording correlated tool call executions and connector lifecycle events.

components.label:
PolicyEngine
(sutra/permissions)
